attribution: Condensed, original index derived from the official Minecraft 26.2/26.3 release notes and NeoForged 26.2 -> 26.3 primer.

entries.change: Data pack 107.1 becomes 121.0; resource pack 88.0 becomes 97.1.
entries.action: Set the applicable pack.mcmeta pack_format while preserving unknown fields.
entries.validation: Parse JSON and verify pack_format matches the pack role.

entries.change: The client windowing, input, and platform backend moves from GLFW to SDL3.
entries.action: Report client/backend references for exact NeoForge 26.3 source review; do not regex-rewrite Java.
entries.validation: Client compile and launch smoke test.

entries.change: GPU data storage, renderer submission, post effects, and render pipeline APIs change.
entries.action: Route renderer-heavy projects to AST/Codex repair with exact 26.3 sources.
entries.validation: Client compile, resource reload, and in-game render smoke test.

entries.change: Number providers split into context_int_provider and context_float_provider registries and types.
entries.action: Flag ambiguous numeric JSON and Java codec usage; preserve input until a typed mapping is known.
entries.validation: Parse affected JSON and exercise the owning feature.

entries.change: Registry references, predicate condition names, and loot function forms are revised or removed.
entries.action: Emit a file-level repair warning; do not flatten inline/reference alternatives automatically.
entries.validation: Data pack parse and loot/predicate test.

entries.change: Block-state JSON fields use the 26.3 names and compact block-id form.
entries.action: Only rewrite fields in known block-state JSON locations and retain unknown fields.

entries.change: surface_rule becomes material_rule; preliminary_surface_level becomes chunk_surface_level; aquifer inputs move into an aquifers object.
entries.action: Apply only shape-preserving renames/moves; flag missing or conflicting fields.
entries.validation: Data parse followed by world creation and chunk-generation smoke test.

entries.change: Ore vein controls move from noise settings into the minecraft:ore_vein material rule.
entries.action: Do not synthesize a material-rule pipeline; emit a manual repair item.
entries.validation: Worldgen registry load and generated chunk comparison.

entries.change: Carver registry and cave/canyon fields are renamed, inlined, removed, or replaced.
entries.action: Flag affected configured carvers for exact target-schema repair.
entries.validation: Worldgen registry load and seed-based chunk comparison.

entries.change: Explorer maps become distinct items and several map, brewing, and component rules change.
entries.action: Report affected recipes, loot tables, tags, and item components for review.
entries.validation: Recipe/loot parse and item behavior test.

entries.change: Whitelist defaults and server-management protocol notifications change.
entries.action: Record server configuration review; do not silently alter operator policy.

entries.change: NeoForge 26.3 dependency and mappings must be pinned to an official artifact before build claims are made.
entries.action: Require explicit -NeoVersion and keep build/runtime gates unverified until the pin is available.
entries.validation: Gradle dependency resolution, compile, client launch, and runtime content checks.
